dedupe_keys.name: agrifireinfo v1 0 open source platform for monitoring and managing open field crop residue burning northeast china

description: A web platform for agencies that monitor and regulate the burning of crop residues in fields. The paper abstract (Fire, 2024) says it gives timely maps of fire spots and emissions, weather and air quality, introduces a Prevention Alarming Index to flag regions prone to burning and promote residue use, and offers burning windows and crop residue yields for controlled burning. The Zenodo package of source code and data (version 1.0, 22 February 2024, a 100 MB ZIP) holds the HTML and JavaScript pages for meteorology and air quality, fire emissions, fire radiative energy, the alarming index, the burn window and crop residue yield, with fire detections from MODIS, VIIRS, NOAA and Himawari-9 as CSV, emission GeoJSON and hourly burn window maps by county and grid for early November 2023. It is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is regional: the city scripts read are for Northeast China (Harbin, Changchun, Anshan and others). Caveats: a sample period only, and live operation needs the authors' data feeds. For simulation it shows how fire and smoke from farming can be forecast, a hazard to roads, airports and power lines near fields. A related catalogue record is the FAO GIEWS Agricultural Stress Index System.
